'''Aleksei Dorne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and later defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Biography==
Born on the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Aleksei and [[Elara Dorne|his sister]] were raised to a highly prestigious Imperial family and rose quickly through the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] ranks.

In [[3643 BBY]], Aleksei contacted his sister when his squad was disavowed by the Empire on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Elara was able to help Aleksei by convincing him and his squad to defect to the Republic.<ref name="SWTOR" />
